plugins.description: 为报告类文档提供代码语法高亮的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。注册一个 highlight_code 工具， 把代码片段渲染成带真实语法配色的产物，落到 Markdown / HTML、Word、PowerPoint、PDF 与 LaTeX 里。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-code-highlight [English](README.en.md) | **中文** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen.svg)](package.json) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4B6BFB.svg)](#安装) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/dshplugin/dsh-plugin-hub) 为**报告类文档**提供代码语法高亮的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。注册一个 `highlight_code` 工具， 把代码片段渲染成带真实语法配色的产物，落到 Markdown / HTML、Word、PowerPoint、PDF 与 LaTeX 里。

## 特性 - **68 种语言** —— 按语言名、别名或文件扩展名解析；没有给定语言时按内容自动识别，识别不出就老实按纯文本处理。 - **10 种输出** —— `html`、`html-file`、`svg`、`svg-png`、`png`、`latex`、`latex-minted`、`markdown`、`ansi`、`text`。 - **7 套主题** —— `paper-light`（文档向）、`github-dark`、`github-light`、`one-dark`、`monokai`、`solarized-light`、`solarized-dark`，另有 `auto`。 - **矢量与位图共用一套几何** —— SVG 与 PNG 由同一个布局模型产出，物理尺寸与逐格位置一致。 - **面向文档的排版参数** —— `width_in`、`dpi`、`font_size_pt`、`line_height`、`show_title`，直接产出能贴进 Word 一页宽的图。 - **直接落盘** —— 给出 `output_file` 就写文件并返回路径，不再把长文回传给模型。 - **不需要浏览器，也不需要 Office** —— PNG 由内置的 Pillow 栅格化器绘制，中文与 ASCII 在固定步进网格上对齐。 - **零运行时 npm 依赖** —— 分词器与渲染器全部自带，离线可用。 ## 安装 ### 从 GitHub 安装（CLI） ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:scientificmaniac/dsh-code-highlight ``` - `--profile` 换成你的 profile 名：DSH Desktop 用 `desktop`，Web 版通常是 `web`。 - Desktop 版请**先完全退出应用**再执行——`dsh plugin` 要独占 profile 的写锁。 - `dsh plugin --profile

` 把参数原样交给 pnpm，所以要固定版本可以直接写 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:scientificmaniac/dsh-code-highlight#v1.0.0`。 ### 在 DSH 会话里安装 让 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager`： ``` action: install_bundle target: <本仓库的绝对路径> ``` 两种方式都用包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入插件条目；安装后 `highlight_code` 对该 profile 的所有会话可用。 修改源码后需要重启 DSH 才会加载新模块。 ### 供其他项目直接引用 ```bash git clone https://github.com/scientificmaniac/dsh-code-highlight.git cd dsh-code-highlight npm test ``` `index.js` 导出 DSH 插件的 `apply` / `inject` / `name`；若只想用渲染能力，可直接引用 `src/` 下的模块： ```js import { resolveLanguage } from 'dsh-code-highlight/src/languages.js'; import { tokenizeLines } from 'dsh-code-highlight/src/tokenize.js'; import { resolveTheme } from 'dsh-code-highlight/src/themes.js'; import { renderHtml } from 'dsh-code-highlight/src/render.js'; ``` ## 用法 | 参数 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `code`（必填） | 要高亮的源码；允许整段被 Markdown 围栏包住。 | | `language` | 语言 id、别名或扩展名，如 `python`、`py`、`ts`、`c++`、`bash`、`sql`、`latex`。省略则自动识别。 | | `format` | 输出格式，默认 `html`。 | | `theme` | 主题 id 或 `auto`。报告排版推荐 `paper-light`。 | | `dark` | 仅 `theme: "auto"` 时生效的明暗偏好，默认深色。 | | `title` | 代码块标签，通常是文件名或片段用途。 | | `show_title` | 是否显示 `title`，默认 `true`；设 `false` 可彻底去掉文件名。 | | `document_title` | 仅 `html-file` 用的文档标题，默认不输出，因此文件名不会变成文档标题。 | | `line_numbers` | 是否显示行号列，默认 `true`。 | | `start_line` | 首行行号，默认 `1`，用于片段摘录。 | | `highlight_lines` | 需要强调的行，如 `"3,7-9"`。 | | `font_size` | 代码字号（CSS 像素），默认 `13`。 | | `font_size_pt` | 代码字号（磅），优先于 `font_size`；1 pt = 4/3 px。 | | `line_height` | 行距倍数，默认 `1.5`；低于 1.3 时中文可能贴近下一行。 | | `tab_size` | 制表符展开宽度，默认 `4`。 | | `canvas` | 目标画布尺寸，如 `"960x540"`。设置后 `svg` 输出为整页尺寸、代码块居中缩放，可直接交给 `univer_compile_svg`。 | | `width_in` | 物理宽度（英寸），如 `6.3`。PNG 像素宽 = `width_in × dpi`，SVG 得到等价的 `width="…in"`。 | | `dpi` | 位图分辨率，默认 `300`；该值写入 PNG，Word 据此换算实际尺寸。 | | `output_file` | 写入此路径并返回路径；相对路径基于会话工作区。`png` 与 `svg-png` 必填。 | | `overwrite` | 允许覆盖已存在文件，默认 `false`。 | | `mono_font` | 栅格化 ASCII 用的字体文件，如 `consola.ttf`。 | | `cjk_font` | 栅格化中日韩等宽字符用的字体文件，如 `msyh.ttc`、`simsun.ttc`。 | ### 格式与落点 | `format` | 产物 | 典型落点 | | --- | --- | --- | | `html` | 全内联样式的 HTML 片段 | Markdown 报告、HTML 报告、邮件、可粘贴的富文本 | | `html-file` | 完整独立 HTML 文档 | 浏览器打开、打印成 PDF | | `svg` | 矢量代码图（可加 `width_in` 定宽） | Word / PPT / PDF 插图；也可交给 `univer_compile_svg` | | `svg-png` | 同版式的 `.svg` + `.png` 一对文件 | 文档需要矢量图与位图兜底时 | | `png` | Pillow 栅格化的位图，含 DPI 元数据 | 无 SVG 支持的编辑器、PDF 排版、快速预览 | | `latex` | `listings` 环境 | `.tex` 报告（pdfLaTeX / XeLaTeX 通用，无需 shell-escape） | | `latex-minted` | `minted` 环境 | 需要 `-shell-escape` 的 `.tex` | | `markdown` | 围栏代码块 | 交给下游 Markdown 渲染器自行着色 | | `ansi` | 24 位色终端文本 | 终端、日志 | | `text` | 原样代码 | 纯文本 | ### 各报告格式的落地流程 - **Markdown / HTML** —— `format: html`，把返回片段写进报告。 - **Word（.docx）** —— `format: svg-png` + `width_in: 6.3`，插入定宽矢量图，或使用同尺寸 PNG。 - **PDF** —— `format: png` 直接排版，或 `format: latex` 由 LaTeX 排版、`html-file` 打印。 - **LaTeX / PDF 论文** —— `format: latex`（`listings`）或 `format: latex-minted`。 - **PowerPoint** —— `format: svg` + `canvas: "960x540"`，再用 `univer_compile_svg` 编译到幻灯片页。 ## 栅格化：为什么中文能对齐 SVG 与 PNG 共用**固定步进网格**：一个 ASCII 单元格固定为 `0.6 × 字号`，CJK 与 emoji 占两个单元格。 排版因此只由几何决定，不依赖浏览器或 Pillow 各自的字体度量。 PNG 绘制时按字符选字体：ASCII 走等宽字体（默认 Consolas），宽字符走 CJK 字体（默认微软雅黑）， 两者落在同一网格起点上——这就是「Consolas 画 ASCII + 中文字体画中文」而不让缩进走样的做法。 字体可用 `mono_font` / `cjk_font` 覆盖。 栅格化依赖 **Python 3 + Pillow**。脚本以 `stdio: ignore` 启动、诊断经临时文件回传， 因此在禁止捕获管道的受限环境里同样可用。解释器按 `python`、`py`、`python3` 依次尝试， 也可用环境变量 `DSH_CODE_HIGHLIGHT_PYTHON` 指定。 ## 架构 ```mermaid flowchart TD invoke(["highlight_code 调用
code · language · format · output_file"]) entry["index.js
参数解析 · 格式分派 · 落盘"] detect["src/detect.js
特征打分"] langs["src/languages.js
68 种语言的词法定义"] tokenize["src/tokenize.js
通用分词器 + 专用扫描模式"] themes["src/themes.js
7 套主题"] render["src/render.js
渲染器 + blockGeometry 共用几何"] raster["py/rasterize.py
Pillow 栅格化器"] invoke --> entry entry -->|"language 省略时"| detect detect --> langs entry --> langs langs --> tokenize tokenize -->|"每行 token"| render themes --> render entry --> render render --> f1["html · html-file"] render --> f2["svg"] render --> f3["latex · latex-minted"] render --> f4["ansi · markdown · text"] render -->|"宽高与缩放"| raster f1 --> d1["Markdown / HTML 报告"] f2 --> d2["Word / PPT / PDF 插图"] f3 --> d3["LaTeX 论文"] raster --> d4["记录 DPI 的位图"] ``` SVG 与 PNG 是同一份几何的两个出口：`render.js` 算出逻辑宽高与缩放系数， 交给 `rasterize.py` 画位图，两者因此物理尺寸一致。 ## 项目结构 ```mermaid flowchart TB repo["dsh-code-highlight/"] repo --> index["index.js
插件入口"] repo --> src["src/"] repo --> py["py/rasterize.py
Pillow 栅格化器"] repo --> tests["tests/"] repo --> scripts["scripts/
示例生成脚本"] repo --> examples["examples/
示例产物"] repo --> manifest["package.json · cordis.patch.yml
locale/ · icon.svg"] repo --> docs["README.md · README.en.md
CONTRIBUTING.md · CHANGELOG.md · LICENSE"] src --> languages["languages.js
68 种语言"] src --> detect["detect.js
语言识别"] src --> tokenize["tokenize.js
分词器"] src --> themes["themes.js
7 套主题"] src --> render["render.js
渲染器 + 共用几何"] tests --> encoding["encoding.mjs
编码守卫"] tests --> smoke["smoke.mjs
112 项断言"] tests --> raster["rasterize.mjs
19 项断言"] ``` ## 开发 ```bash npm test # 编码守卫 + 冒烟测试（无需 Python） npm run test:raster # PNG 链路测试（需要 Python 3 + Pillow） node scripts/make-doc-figure.mjs # 生成配对的 SVG + PNG 文档插图 ``` `npm test` 覆盖分词往返不变式（68 种语言 × 压力样本，输出拼回必须等于输入）、 渲染矩阵（语言 × 主题 × 格式）、语言自动识别、画布与英寸排版、`show_title` 去重与 CJK 双格宽度。 详细报告写入 `smoke-report.txt`。 ## 语言一览 通用编程语言：JavaScript、TypeScript、Python、Java、Kotlin、Scala、Groovy、C、C++、C#、Go、Rust、Swift、 Ruby、PHP、Perl、Lua、R、MATLAB、Julia、Dart、Elixir、Erlang、Haskell、Clojure、Lisp、F#、Visual Basic、 Pascal、Fortran、Assembly、COBOL、Solidity、Verilog、GLSL、GDScript、Apex、Zig、Nim、OCaml、PowerShell、 Shell、Fish、Batch、Vim Script、AWK。 配置与数据：JSON、YAML、TOML、INI / properties / dotenv、XML、HTML、CSS / SCSS / LESS、Markdown、 Dockerfile、Makefile / CMake、Nginx、HTTP、Protocol Buffers、GraphQL、Terraform / HCL、Nix、Mermaid、 CSV / TSV、Diff / Patch、LaTeX、纯文本。 ## 已知限制 - 一次处理一个代码片段；不做整篇报告的批量扫描。 - `width_in` 只把图缩到栏宽以内，不会把短片段放大到正好一页宽。 - HTML 中内嵌的 `

plugins.description: DSH web plugin: per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row — per-turn spend and cache-hit / cache-miss totals (CNY), priced from an official price table refreshed on demand. · DSH 网页插件：输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊——逐轮花费与命中/未命中两项总额（CNY），价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bottom-cost

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **session cost** chip for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): it sits in the same row as the built-in stats pills under the composer and answers "what has this conversation cost" and "what did the last turn cost" at a glance, splitting the spend into **cache-hit** and **cache-miss** parts.

![The cost chip in the composer stats row, and its expanded panel](docs/session-cost-panel.png)

## Install

### Option 1 — install it from the DSH UI (simplest)

1. Open **插件 → 添加插件** (Plugins → Add plugin) in the sidebar;
2. Paste the repository URL: `https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-bottom-cost`;
3. Click **安装** (Install), then **restart DeepSeek Harness** as its banner tells you to (close the running `dsh` process and start it again, e.g. `dsh web`).

The host half is a Node module, so **a config reload alone will not import it** — that restart is not optional. Once restarted, open the UI and the chip is there; no page refresh needed.

### Option 2 — let your AI install it

Paste this whole block into any AI that can read and write your machine (an agent inside DSH, Claude Code, Codex — anything):

```text
Install the DSH plugin at https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-bottom-cost into my DeepSeek Harness:
clone the repo, run `node tools/install.mjs`, and tell me when I need to restart DSH.
```

### Option 3 — from the plugin market (once listed)

DSH plugins are distributed as packages; look for **dsh-bottom-cost** in [dshmarket](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market). Until it is listed, use option 1 or 2.

### Option 4 — from source (developers)

For hacking on it, or for a non-default profile:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-bottom-cost
cd dsh-bottom-cost
node tools/install.mjs              # copy into the profile's node_modules + append one loader line
node tools/install.mjs --dry-run    # print what it would do, write nothing
node tools/install.mjs web          # target another profile (default: desktop)
```

It is idempotent — re-run it after a `git pull` to sync an update — and it resolves your DSH home the way the harness does (`$DSH_HOME`, then `~/.dsh`). This route needs a restart too. After that, changing `lib/client.js` only needs a page refresh; changing `lib/index.js` still needs a restart.

The plugin has **no runtime dependencies at all** (its shape validation is a ~90-line file it ships, `lib/shape.js`), so this route installs nothing from the network. That is also why it installs by **copy** rather than a directory junction: a junction gets realpath-resolved back into the clone, so any future bare import of a third-party package would fail to resolve there at load time.

## How to read the UI

In the screenshot: the bottom line is the **stats row under the composer** — `◎ ¥5.294 · ¥0.9230` is this plugin, sitting in the same row as the built-in `15 轮 388 步 · 228 tok/s` (session stats) and `147M tok · 缓存命中 99%` (token usage) pills, with the context meter at the far right. Above it is the **expanded panel**.

**The chip in the stats row**

```
◎ ¥2.922 · ¥0.4877
  ↑ left                ↑ right
this conversation's     the latest turn's
total spend             spend
```

- The **left** number is what this conversation has cost so far; the **right** number is what the most recent turn cost. Both update live as the conversation goes on.
- With nothing billable yet, the chip is hidden — the same "no content, no render" behaviour as the built-in stats pills.

**Click the chip and the panel opens upward**

- **Fixed header**: the conversation's total spend, split into **cache-hit** and **cache-miss** (`¥1.609` and `¥1.313` in the screenshot). Those two always add up to the total on the chip — the identity `total = hit + miss` holds by construction, not by rounding luck.
- **Scrolling list**: **every turn's** spend, three rows each — **total / cache-hit / cache-miss** (turns 7 and 8 in the screenshot). It starts at the newest turn; **scroll up** to walk back through earlier ones.
- **The scrolling window is exactly two turn blocks tall** — you came here to see this turn and the previous one, and the panel does not have to grow tall for that.

**The 刷新 (Refresh) button, top right**

It is about the **price list used for pricing**, not about re-counting your conversation. Clicking it makes the host fetch the **official Chinese price page**, parse its 12 unit prices and validate every one, then **show you the diff first** (which line changed, from what to what) — nothing is applied until you click **采用 (Apply)**. That extra step exists because DeepSeek publishes **no machine-readable price API**, only a human-facing docs page, so parsing it can fail; a bad parse applied silently would corrupt every number you look at.

The panel's second line — `价目：官方页 · 10/13 02:17` — tells you **which price list is active and when it was fetched**. If it says `价目：内置表`, no fetch has happened yet and the built-in table shipped with the plugin is in use.

**Do you need to click it often?** No. Once when the official prices change. After you apply, **the whole conversation is instantly re-priced** (money is computed in the browser from the active price list; history stores only token facts), so you never end up with two generations of prices mixed into one ledger.

## Where the numbers come from

Only the **official DeepSeek routes** have a published price list, so only they produce money:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Hit spend** | cache-read tokens × hit price |
| **Miss spend** | (uncached input + cache-write) × miss price **+** output tokens × output price |
| **Peak / off-peak** | Beijing time Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 are peak (double price); weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak all day |
| **When it is priced** | At the instant each call happened, taken from the session event's own timestamp — so replaying months-old history is priced with the tariff of *that* moment, not today's |
| **Other providers** | Never guessed at ¥0: they show as *unpriced*, and the panel reports how many calls were unpriced |

Scope is the **current conversation's own turns**. A subagent is a different session and is deliberately not folded in, so the chip's numbers line up one-to-one with the turns you can see.

### It is an estimate, not a bill

Prices are estimated from token counts and the published tariff. The plugin never reads your balance, never touches credentials, and cannot see what DeepSeek actually deducted.

### The `deepseek-v4-pro` tier is disputed

The price rules carry a time fence — a rule **copied into this plugin's source** in the same spirit as [`@linxin666/dsh-usage`](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web) (a provenance note, not a runtime dependency — see "No runtime coupling" below): **after 2026-09-14 12:00 Beijing, `deepseek-v4-pro` requests are billed at the Flash row.**

The official price page still lists `deepseek-v4-pro` on **its own, 3–7.5× more expensive row** (miss 4.5/9.0, output 13.5/27.0). The documentation cannot prove which tier the runtime actually charges. Rather than guess, the plugin keeps the fence and **marks the affected turns** with `按Flash档估`, plus a summary line in the panel. To price them at the official pro row instead, set `V4_PRO_FOLDED_INTO_FLASH_AT_MS` in `lib/pricing.js` to `0`.

## The full price-refresh flow

1. The host fetches the **official Chinese price page** (`api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing`, which quotes CNY; the English page quotes USD and is not used).
2. It parses the table and validates all 12 unit prices — if any single one is missing or implausible, the whole parse is rejected.
3. It shows you **the diff**; **采用 (Apply)** commits it, **放弃 (Discard)** throws it away.

The price list is stored in `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-bottom-cost/pricebook.json` (atomic write) and survives restarts. A failed fetch (offline, timeout, redesigned page) is reported and **keeps the current prices**; the built-in table remains the first-run fallback.

### Capability boundary

- **One outbound request**, to the public docs page above, **only when you click 刷新**. Nothing else ever leaves t

# dsh-web-api-balance

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2f855a?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0969da?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4f46e5?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
![no build step](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-none%20%C2%B7%20source%20only-6b7280?style=flat-square)
![no dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-6b7280?style=flat-square)

<!-- README-I18N:START -->

**中文** | [English](./README.en.md)

<!-- README-I18N:END -->

在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面里显示 DeepSeek API 余额，顺便算一下当前这条对话花了多少钱。

![示意图：输入框旁的余额胶囊，悬停展开余额与消耗两栏](assets/preview.svg)

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-api-balance@1.0.5
```

版本号建议钉死，升级时手动改。DSH 升级、或者这个仓库更新，都不会顺手把你装的插件换掉，这点是故意的。

npm 连不上就从 Release 装，同一个文件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance/releases/download/v1.0.5/dsh-web-api-balance-1.0.5.tgz
```

从源码装也可以。`dsh plugin` 认仓库 URL 和 `github:owner/repo` 简写（会先探一次 GitHub 连通性），
`#` 后面会被 pnpm 当 git ref，所以能钉到 commit：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Charaaah/dsh-web-api-balance#<commit-sha>
```

装完刷一下页面。如果你之前用 `link:` 或 `file:` 装过同一个版本号，直接 `add` 不会替换它，pnpm 会认为
版本已满足然后跳过，得先 remove。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-api-balance
```

这条是转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，所以会卸掉包和 `package.json` 里那行依赖。`dsh.profile.bundles`
不会跟着清。那是 DSH 的字段，pnpm 不认识，得自己编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` 把包名删掉：

```jsonc
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
  "dshmarket"
  // 删掉这行："dsh-web-api-balance"
] } }
```

留着会指向一个不存在的包，启动时会报。市场页面的插件开关会帮你把这两步一起做，命令行不会。

下面几样卸载不管，需要的话自己清：

- `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 里的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。这是 DSH 凭证服务的条目，「设置 → 模型」写进去的
  也是同一个，你可能在别处还在用，所以插件不动它。
- profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里手工写的那段 `- id: dsh-web-api-balance`。包没了以后这行会被忽略，
  但里面可能写着 `apiKey`。
- `localStorage` 的 `dsh-web-api-balance:last`，存的是金额和时间戳，没有凭证。

npm 上的版本删不掉（版本号不可变），所以卸载只影响本机，想装回来随时 `add` 一次就行。

## 界面

只有一处 UI：输入框工具栏、发送键左边的常驻胶囊，显示总余额。鼠标移上去（或者键盘聚焦）弹出浮层，
左右两栏，中间一条竖线：

```
总余额      ¥15.00  │   本次对话消耗     梁文谷
充值余额    ¥13.50  │   缓存命中    1,000,000   ¥0.30
赠送余额     ¥1.50  │   缓存未命中  2,000,000   ¥18.00
更新时间    20:00:00│   输出          500,000   ¥13.50
来源        DeepSeek 账号│   ────────────────────────────
                    │   合计                    ¥31.80
```

左栏是账户余额，右栏是这条会话的消耗。没有用量报告时右栏和竖线一起消失，只剩单栏。两栏顶部对齐，
账户栏不必重复胶囊上已经有的名字，也没单独再打一遍总额，总额就是「总余额」那行。

胶囊本身切成两半，没有额外按钮也没有文字：

- 左半边是圆点加金额，点一下立即刷新。
- 右半边是一条 22px 的竖条加钱包加号图标，平时宽度 0、完全看不见，鼠标进胶囊才滑出来，点击在新标签页
  打开充值页。

静止状态下它就是个干净的数字。取不到余额时也没有金额可充，整个右半边不渲染，胶囊变红，浮层里写明
原因。

充值地址优先用账号服务给的 `AccountView.links.topUpUrl`，这样指向内部 Platform 的部署会跳自己的站点；
拿不到就用公开的 `https://platform.deepseek.com/top_up`。浏览器半侧内置了同一个兜底，宿主没报告
地址时右半边也能用。

余额走 DeepSeek 官方的 `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`，登录了账号时走 DSH 自己的账号服务。

## 消耗怎么算的

官方的 token 计数看不出花了多少钱，右栏就把这条会话的累计用量按人民币拆开，三个计费桶各一行：

| 行 | 取数 |
|---|---|
| 缓存命中 | `tokenUsage.cacheReadTokens` |
| 缓存未命中 | `tokenUsage.uncachedInputTokens` + `cacheWriteTokens` |
| 输出 | `tokenUsage.outputTokens` |
| 合计 | 上面三项之和 |

官方 schema 里 `prompt_tokens = prompt_cache_hit_tokens + prompt_cache_miss_tokens`，这三行能覆盖全部
计费 token。缓存本身不额外收费，落盘、存储、过期都不进账单，只有 token 按这三档计价。

用量是宿主从整条会话日志折出来的官方回报值，价格则按 `useProjection('modelSelection')` 里的当前路由查表。
两个投影都是宿主推的，有回报就更新，不用额外请求，也不往外发数据。

价格表是写死的，在 `client.js` 的 `PRICING` 里，单位元每百万 tokens。官方调价了改这一个对象。表里没有的
模型不猜，照样显示 token 数，金额位置写「未收录该模型价格」。旧名字 `deepseek-v4-flash` 和
`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 按官方说明归到 `deepseek-flash`。

峰谷这块容易看错，多说两句。右栏标题右边那个名字就是当前档位：北京时间工作日 9:00–12:00 和 14:00–18:00
显示「梁文峰」，其余时间「梁文谷」，后者半价。判断是拿当前时刻先算成 UTC+8 再读时钟，浏览器在哪个
时区都一样。

两个已知的坑：一是我没做节假日，插件不带日历，法定假日的工作日会显示梁文峰、把价格算高。二是累计用量里
没有每次请求的时间戳，跨了峰谷的会话没法归到某一档，这个名字的意思只是「此刻发请求按哪档价」。

另外，flash 和 pro 不是一个价。单价从 modelSelection 投影的当前路由查，表里两套价分开（命中 ¥0.04 / ¥0.30，
未命中 ¥2 / ¥9，输出 ¥8 / ¥27，都是高峰价）。路由带不带 `deepseek-official/` 前缀都能对上。`next` 优先于
`lastUsed`，你刚在模型选择器里改过、下次请求才用的那个，显示的就是它。

数字是当前会话的累计，不含子代理（它们各自是独立会话），也不是账号的历史账单。要看账号侧的消耗去官方
平台的用量页。

还有一点：累计用量是一条会话一个总数，里面没记哪段用了哪个模型。一条会话中途从 flash 换成 pro，
整条会按当前模型的单价算。换过就是估值，没换过就是准的。会话切换时组件会重挂，用量是按每条会话的
日志分别折的，不会串。

## 凭证

一般不用填。宿主按这个顺序取，两条路都不用你手输：

1. 账号授权（`deepseekAccount.getBalance`）。就是「设置 → 账号」登录 DeepSeek 之后写入的那个 OAuth 授权，
   这条路上没有 API Key。
2. 已保存的 API Key。`config.apiKey` 优先，留空就去凭证服务里找 `config.apiKeyEnv` 指定的引用，默认
   `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。这跟「设置 → 模型」填 DeepSeek key 时写进 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的是同一个
   条目，早就配过 key 的话直接就能读；启动 dsh 的进程环境里有同名变量也行。

两条都没有时胶囊显示「余额不可用」，浮层写具体原因，不会静默失败。浮层底部会标这次数字来自哪条路。

宿主半侧为什么必须有：余额接口不带 CORS 头，而且 API Key 不能进浏览器。`host.js` 因此拿着凭证发请求、
缓存结果，在 `/plugins/dsh-web-api-balance/balance` 上出一份 JSON（`?refresh=1` 强制实时查），`client.js`
只 fetch 这个同源路由。路由和页面其它请求走同一套会话令牌鉴权。

## 配置

写在 web profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `id: dsh-web-api-balance` 那行。不配也能用：

```yaml
- id: dsh-web-api-balance
  disabled: false
  inject: [webServer]
  config:
    apiKey: ''                       # 单独指定 key 时填 sk-...（优先级最高）
    apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY      # 否则用这个凭证引用 / 环境变量名
    baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
    refreshSeconds: 300              # 缓存窗口，30-86400 秒
```

顺序是账号授权 → `config.apiKey` → 凭证服务的 `apiKeyEnv` → 同名环境变量，谁先命中用谁。

## 行为和边界

宿主按 `refreshSeconds` 缓存，并发的读共用一次上游调用。账号授权那条走 DSH 自己的服务、不发外部 HTTP；
未登录（返回 `null`）时落到 API Key 那条。浏览器每 5 分钟自动刷一次，点胶囊立即刷。最近一次成功的摘要
存进 `localStorage`，页面刷新先显示旧值再更新。上游返 401/403 归为「key 无效」，不反复重试。

浮层只在悬停或聚焦时渲染，平时不占位，设了 `pointer-events: none` 不会挡住点击。「本次对话消耗」那栏
只在宿主报告过用量之后出现，新会话什么都没发时整栏连同竖线都不渲染。金额留两位小数，不够一分的留三位，
免得显示成 `¥0.00`。样式只用宿主主题令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`），浅色深色都跟随。

路由返回的 JSON 就是浏览器半侧渲染用的：

```jsonc
{
  "ok": true,
  "source": "account" | "api-key",  // 这次数字来自哪条凭证路
  "topUpUrl": "https://platform.deepseek.com/top_up",
  "available": true,                 // 上游 is_available；false 表示余额已耗尽
  "total": 15, "toppedUp": 13.5, "granted": 1.5,
  "currency": "CNY",
  "checkedAt": 1791587145212
}
// 失败时：{ "ok": false, "reason": "...", "message": "...", "checkedAt": ... }
```

## 隐私

包里没有凭证，也不往任何地方回传数据。代码里没有 API Key 字面量，key 只在运行时从插件配置、凭证服务
（`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，DSH 自己维护）或启动进程的环境变量里读。它唯一的去处是 `Authorization:
Bearer` 头，目标就是余额接口本身（默认 `api.deepseek.com`），没有遥测、没有日志打印、没有第三方请求。
key 也不进浏览器，浏览器半侧只读同源路由返回的几个数字，唯一写本地的是 `localStorage` 里的余额摘要。

打包出来 14 个文件（`LICENSE`、`README.md`、`README.en.md`、`client.js`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`host.js`、
`icon.svg`、`index.js`、`locale/{en,zh}.json`、`package.json`、`release.json`、`assets/preview{,.en}.svg`），
两个测试脚本、构建脚本、任何 profile 状态和任何凭证都不在里面。Release 上的 tarball 和 npm 上的是同一条
`npm pack` 命令打出来的，两条安装路径装到的是同一份字节。

## 开发

两个脚本，只依赖 Node 标准库，不需要 profile 的 node_modules：

```sh
node smoke-test.mjs   # 浏览器半侧
node host-test.mjs    # 宿主半侧
```

`smoke-test.mjs` 用桩模块加载器和带状态的 React 垫片加载 `client.js`，验槽位注册和字典解析，驱动胶囊走
「失败 → 悬停展开 → 点击刷新成功 → 明细齐全」，另外验右半边在无余额时不渲染、有余额时点击用正确的 URL
新开标签页、宿主没给地址时的兜底，以及消耗栏：没有用量时不渲染、三个桶的 token 数与金额逐项对上
`deepseek-v4-pro` 高峰价、合计正确、未知模型只报 token 不报金额、旧模型名走别名价。

`host-test.mjs` 起一个假的 DeepSeek `/user/balance`，把插件的路由挂到真实 HTTP 上跑通缓存命中、强制刷新、
401、环境变量回退、无凭证、账号授权优先、未登录回退到已存 key，以及充值地址。

发布脚本在 `publish/` 下，也不随包发布。这台机器没有 git，所以推仓库是走 GitHub REST API 的
blob → tree → commit → ref 四步，最后读回来校验：

```powershell
node publish/build-repo.mjs --owner Charaaah   # 生成 publish/repo/，补公开元数据和 release.json
node publish/pack-npm.mjs                      # npm pack --ignore-scripts，产物即发 npm 的那份
$env:DSH_GH_TOKEN = '<token>'                  # 只在当前会话里，不落盘
node publish/push-github.mjs --dry-run         # 先看计划
node publish/push-github.mjs
node publish/release-github.mjs                # 打 tag、建 Release、挂 tarball
$env:NPM_TOKEN = '<token>'
node publish/publish-npm.mjs                   # 发的是已打包好的那一份
```

# INFJ Sage · 老绿 **A pixel-art INFJ-A companion that lives inside your DeepSeek Harness window.** **Just here to accompany Qiangwei.** 这是绿老头，不是brother：陪你专注、等你决定，也陪你安静地打个盹。

The sage is not a progress bar. It reads what your agents are already doing — working, waiting on you, resting — and answers with a small, quiet reaction in character. Six semantic states, drawn from a nine-animation sprite sheet where each pose expresses a different facet of the INFJ description on the reference card. While you work it sits and reads, turning its pages. It only runs when you pick it up. \--- ## What it does |Pose|When it appears|Trait it expresses| |-|-|-| |静观 Observing|Nothing is running|独处即充电 — recharged alone| |阅读 Reading|At least one session is working, or a watched turn just finished|先看模式，再看任务 — patterns before tasks| |共情 Empathy|A session is waiting on your answer|先接住情绪 — feelings first| |充电 Recharging|Idle past the nap delay|独处即充电 — the quiet half| |受挫 Setback|A turn ended in an error|过载时向内自责 — overload turns inward| |带我去哪儿 Carried|While you are dragging it|理想主义的续航 — carried, not chasing| Around that core: * **Click** the sage and it says something in character. * **Drag** it anywhere; it snaps to the edge and remembers where you left it. * **It reads while you work** — an open book, eyes following the page, a quiet page turn. It never paces about on its own. * **It runs only when carried** — pick it up and it runs in the direction you take it, turning around at the screen edge so it never looks like it is running out of the window. * **Right-click** for settings: session scope, size, nap delay, palette, motion, idle glances, auto-tips, position reset, tuck away, and a trait panel. * **Idle glances** — while resting, the sage looks around using the sheet's sixteen drawn head poses. * Follows DSH's language, light/dark theme, and reduce-motion preference. * No build step to install, no runtime dependencies, no network calls, no model calls. This is an **in-window** companion, not an operating-system desktop overlay. ### Quoted lines Several reading lines are short quotations, attributed in the interface under the line they belong to — the speech bubble cites the book, and this page records the full source. They are brief, individually attributed, and used in a non-commercial companion; the project claims no rights in them. |Line|Source| |-|-| |如果我进来，走进你独处的时间……我只是来给你的窗上装好玻璃，冬天的风就要来了。|《务虚笔记》 — named by the project owner; edition not yet pinned| |死是一件不必急于求成的事。|《我与地坛》| |太阳，他每时每刻都是夕阳也都是旭日。|《我与地坛》| |我常觉得这中间有着宿命的味道。|《我与地坛》| The sage cites the book, not the author's name: the title is what a reader needs to find the passage, and it keeps the attribution to a fact rather than a byline. Where a line could not be checked against a published edition, this project says so — the first row above is recorded that way rather than being presented as confirmed. Titles are referenced for the remaining states; no passage is reproduced beyond the short lines listed here. \--- ## Install ### 1\. From npm Package page: [dsh-plugin-infj-pet on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-infj-pet). Enter the package name in DSH's plugin installation page (sidebar → **Plugins**): ```text dsh-plugin-infj-pet ``` To pin this release, use `dsh-plugin-infj-pet@1.0.1`. ### 2\. From GitHub ``` github:CN-Mg/dsh\_infj\_pet ``` Or with a pinned tag: ``` github:CN-Mg/dsh\_infj\_pet#v1.0.1 ``` The committed source already contains the built client bundle, so a Git install needs no build step. ### 3\. From a local folder Point the installer at the absolute path of this directory, or pack it first: ```sh npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination artifacts ``` After enabling the plugin, **fully quit DSH and reopen it**. Closing the window may not quit the application, and the browser bundle is only picked up on boot. To remove it: disable the row on the Plugins page, then uninstall the package. \--- ## Using it * **Click** — a line of dialogue, different each time. * **Drag** — reposition; release near a side and it snaps to that edge. * **Right-click** — settings and pose preview. * **Keyboard** — `Tab` to the sage, `Enter`/`Space` to poke, `Esc` to close. * **Session scope** — *All sessions* counts ordinary sessions on the current Host; *This session* follows only the one you are looking at. Child (subagent) sessions are never counted as your sessions, so a delegated burst does not look like your own work. * **Nap delay** — how long the sage stays quiet before it dozes off. * **Size** — 1×, 2×, or 3× the sprite's own pixels. Every size is a whole-number multiple, because pixel art resampled at a fractional scale turns to mush. ### Completion is never guessed The celebratory leap fires only on a **falling edge of work the sage actually watched running**. A page that loads into an already-idle Host, a dropped connection, or a session that simply disappears never produces a celebration. Cancelled and failed turns are not successes. \--- ## Privacy and runtime boundaries * Reads session **identity and status** only — never message content, tool arguments, or transcripts. * Makes **no model calls**, opens **no ports**, sends **no telemetry**, and answers **no approvals** on your behalf. * Uses DSH's existing authenticated connection. * The sprite sheet is embedded in the bundle, so the plugin issues **no network request at all**. * Preferences live in `localStorage` under `dsh-plugin-infj-pet:v1`. * Writes only to its own DOM nodes and to one `

# @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete

[中文](#中文) | [English](#english)

---

## 中文

给 DeepSeek Harness Desktop加一个**会话永久删除**动作。

DSH 只提供「归档」：会话日志是 append-only 的，`dsh-session-persistence`
没有任何删除方法，`dsh-workspace` 注册表也没有 `removeSession`。这个插件把
已有的公开服务组合成一个真正的删除操作，并把入口挂到侧栏会话行的 `…` 菜单里。

### 安装

包名：**`@nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete`**

#### 方式一：DSH 插件页（推荐，桌面版和 Web 版都适用）

1. 打开 DSH 的 **插件** 页面；
2. 在「添加插件」里填入包名和版本：

```
@nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1
```

3. 按页面结果操作。**桌面版需要完全退出并重启应用**——bundle 选择是启动时读取的，
   配置 HMR 不会重新读 profile 的 `package.json`。

安装器会自动把包加入 profile 依赖、把 bundle 选进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，包内的
`cordis.patch.yml` 随层生效，**不需要手改任何配置文件**。

#### 方式二：`dsh plugin` 命令行

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1
dsh plugin --profile web     add @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1
```

官方桌面版的 `dsh` 命令默认不在 `PATH` 里，需要先在应用里注册自带的命令
（应用菜单中的 **Manage dsh Command…**），并在完全退出应用后使用 `desktop` profile。
从 npm 安装时 `--profile` 换成你自己的 profile 名。

#### 方式三：不用 `dsh plugin` 的手动兜底

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop          # 或你的 profile 目录
pnpm add @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1
```

然后在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 里确认两处（安装器正常情况下会自己写）：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": { "@nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete": "0.1.1" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* …, */ "@nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete" ] } }
}
```

重启应用生效。

#### 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete
```

或在插件页点卸载。卸载只移除插件本身，**不会**删除任何已有会话。

#### 兼容性

针对 DSH **`0.2.0-rc.2`** 开发与验证。插件依赖下面这些宿主接口，DSH 升级后可能需要跟着更新：

`Workspace.detachSession`、`workspaceRegistry.archiveSession / unarchiveSession / unpinSession`、
`sessionPersistence.list / resolveCurrentLog`、Connection 的 `/api` exact Fetch 路由注册、
`api-session/removed` 转发事件、以及客户端插件的 `dsh.client` 约定与平台种子模块表。

其中只有 `resolveCurrentLog` 缺失会自动退回布局复刻，其余缺失会降级成警告或明确拒绝，
不会静默删错东西。

### 行为

**只加一个入口**：会话行悬停出现的 `…` 菜单里多一项 **永久删除**（红色，order 500，
排在归档 400 之后）。不加行内悬停按钮。

1. **预检**：解析会话（先查活动会话，再查持久化列表），并从宿主拿到它真实的日志位置，
   同时把「能不能安全删」全部判完——这一段有任何拒绝都发生在改动任何状态之前；
2. **确认对话框**：显示会话标题和不可恢复的提示，取消不做任何写入；
3. **确认后**：
   - 会话若还在跑回合：先经注册表自己的归档准入接缝（`archiveSession({stopActivity:true})`）
     停掉这些工作，并把借用的归档标记恢复原状（本来没归档就收回，本来就在归档集合里
     就保留），然后才继续；
   - 从工作区记账中摘除（`Workspace.detachSession`，会持久化并推送变更）；
   - 从归档集合、置顶集合中摘除；
   - 永久删除会话日志目录与投影缓存文档；
   - 发出 `api-session/removed`，浏览器会话列表立即去掉这一行。

**不可恢复。** 没有回收站、没有备份、没有撤销。

### 永久删除怎么做到失败也安全

直接 `rm -rf` 会在中途失败时留下半棵目录树，而 DSH 下一次启动仍会把它当成会话读。
所以删除走两步隔离：

```
rename(会话目录 → ~/.dsh/sessions/.dsh-session-delete-<随机>/<会话id>/)   ← 同卷，原子
  → 重新 lstat 校验身份（dev/ino/birthtimeNs 与改记账前一致；目录 size 会随内容
     变化，不算身份）
  → rm(隔离目录, recursive, force:false)
  → 再 stat 一次确认真的没了
```

- 身份对不上（删除期间被换掉）：**放回原位**，什么都不删，报 `unsafe-location`；
- `rm` 中途失败：报错并告知隔离目录的完整路径，`~/.dsh/sessions/` 下不会留下会被误读的目录，只会留下一个 `.dsh-session-delete-*` 待你处理；
- 全部成功才清理隔离目录本身。测试断言：删除完成后 `.dsh-session-delete-*` 一个不剩。

### 位置与安全

- **位置来自宿主**：会话目录优先取 `sessionPersistence.resolveCurrentLog(id)` 的答案，
  只有后端答不出来时才退回本插件对布局的复刻（复刻有测试对着真实目录逐条核对）。
  后端答案必须满足 `<sessions根>/<项目目录>/<会话id>/transcript` 的形状，否则拒绝。
- **符号链接防护**：删除前用 `lstat` + `realpath` 证明目标是真目录、父目录就是
  `~/.dsh/sessions/` 下的项目目录、且解析后仍在 sessions 根内（harness home 本身
  经符号链接 / junction 到达时两边都按解析后的路径比较，不会被误判成越界）。指向别处
  就拒绝——测试会造一个 junction 指向根外目录，断言拒绝并且目标文件完好无损。
- **拒绝不留副作用**：身份检查、位置检查、运行中检查都排在第一次持久化写入之前。
  任何拒绝之后，会话仍然在工作区原位、仍然在原有归档/置顶状态，日志一个字节没动。
- **请求加固**：只接受 POST + `application/json`；浏览器请求必须同源且带
  `x-dsh-session-delete-confirmation: delete-session`（链接和 HTML 表单设不了自定义头，
  所以跨站导航打不到这个分支；同源判定是 Origin 与请求自身 Host 的主机名比对，
  http 或 https 都算）；会话 id 必须匹配 `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}`；请求体先查
  `content-length`、再核对读到的长度，超过 8 KiB 直接 413。无 `Origin` 的原生调用方
  （CLI / Agent 直接 POST loopback）由宿主信任栅栏认证，不需要那个头。

### 已知边界

- **正在运行的会话**：插件会先停掉它的回合再删。停不下来（宿主没提供归档准入接缝，
  或者停完仍是 live）才拒绝，返回 `session-delete/running`（HTTP 409），并且此时
  一个文件都没动，归档状态也和删除前完全一样：本来没归档的仍然没归档，把它的工作
  停掉再重试即可；本来就在归档集合里的会保持归档，需要先去侧栏的「显示已归档」筛选里
  取消归档再重试。当前正在对话的这个会话通常属于这一类（它始终 live）。
- 会话的图片/文件附件是内容寻址的**全局**存储，其它会话可能共享，所以删除不动
  `~/.dsh/attachments`。这会留下孤儿字节，但不会误删别人的数据。
- **清理中途失败**：工作区记账摘除之后，文件步骤（改名 / rm）仍可能失败。此时会话
  已经不属于任何工作区（侧栏刷新后行会消失），磁盘上可能留下 `.dsh-session-delete-*`
  隔离目录或投影缓存文档；错误信息会说明失败原因（已隔离的会给出隔离目录完整路径），
  重试一次通常能删干净，也可以按路径手工清理。
- `session_projcache` 的内存表保留该会话那一行直到重启；磁盘文档已删除，且没有
  日志的会话不会再被水合，所以不影响使用。
- **删掉就没了**。要保留内容，请先用官方的 `/export` 命令导出一份 ZIP。
- 与 [`dsh-session-delete`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-delete)（vtxf 的
  同名插件）**不能同时装**：两者都注册 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`，菜单里会
  出现两个删除项。它侧重目录级批量归档/删除，本插件侧重单会话删除的失败安全与
  运行中会话的处理。

### 开发

仓库根就是包根。产物只有 `lib/client.js` 一个文件：

```
dsh-session-delete/
  package.json        main → src/index.js、./client → lib/client.js、dsh.bundle.patch
  cordis.patch.yml    bundle 补丁层：插入一行 Loader entry
  src/index.js        宿主半（源码 = 产物：删除编排 + /api/session.delete 路由）
  src/client.js       浏览器半源码：工厂体，用 require/exports/module
  lib/client.js       浏览器半产物：build-client.mjs 套上 lazy-CJS 外壳
  scripts/build-client.mjs  唯一的构建步骤；--check 校验产物是否过期
  test/host-half.mjs        宿主半端到端（临时 DSH_HOME，真删文件）
  test/browser-half.mjs     浏览器半（在 Node 里物化 lib/client.js，桩掉 React 与 fetch）
  test/verify-endpoint.mjs  对运行中的实例核对路径推导与可达性
  test/deployment-check.mjs 对 verify-endpoint 的回归（桩宿主：404 已挂载 / 报错要说清 URL）
```

宿主半不需要构建：DSH 的 Loader 用 `import` 加载它，`main` 直接指向 `src/index.js`。

浏览器半需要构建：DSH 只服务一个文件（`exports["./client"]`），它必须自己调用
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`，而模块表**没有相对加载器**，所以外壳
不能写进源码再 import。外壳由 `scripts/build-client.mjs` 套上——源码保持可读，产物
可复现（`npm run build:check` 校验产物是否过期）。

```sh
npm run build     # 生成 lib/client.js
npm test          # 宿主半 75 项 + 浏览器半 47 项 + 部署检查 2 项
npm run verify    # 对运行中的 DSH 实例核对（需应用在跑）
npm run check     # build:check + test，prepublishOnly 会自动跑
```

`npm run verify` 不依赖任何机器相关的写死路径：harness home 走 `DSH_HOME`（默认
`~/.dsh`）经插件自己的解析器，base URL 依次取命令行参数、`DSH_WEB_URL`、
再依次探测 19387 / 3000 / 8080 / 8000 / 5173。它只能确认「根目录存在 + 有 DSH 宿主
在跑」；**无法判断路由是否挂载**——未认证请求会被信任栅栏统一挡成 401，无论路由
在不在。要判定挂载，请用它在 Web UI 控制台里打印的那条已认证 fetch。

本包**没有任何运行时依赖**：客户端只用平台种子模块表里的
`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`、
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`。

### 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

---

## English

Adds one **permanent session delete** action to DeepSeek Harness (Desktop and Web).

DSH ships archive only: the session log is append-only, `dsh-session-persistence`
exposes no delete, and the Workspace registry has no `removeSession`. This plugin
composes the existing public services into a real delete and mounts the entry in
the sidebar session row's `…` menu.

### Install

Package name: **`@nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete`**

**Plugins page (recommended):** open DSH → **Plugins**, then add
`@nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1`. The installer adds the profile dependency,
selects the bundle in `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the package's own
`cordis.patch.yml` applies as a layer — no configuration file is edited by hand.
**Desktop requires a full app restart**, because bundle selection is read at startup.

**CLI:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1
dsh plugin --profile web     add @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1
```

The official Desktop build does not put `dsh` on `PATH`; register the bundled
command first (**Manage dsh Command…** in the app menu) and use the `desktop`
profile after fully quitting the app.

**Manual fallback:** in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>`, run
`pnpm add @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete@0.1.1`, then confirm the name appears in
both `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` of that profile's `package.json`.

**Uninstall:** `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @nakie-zjm/dsh-session-delete`,
or use the Plugins page. Uninstalling never deletes existing sessions.

**Compatibility:** built and verified against DSH **`0.2.0-rc.2`**.

### Behaviour

One entry only: a red **Delete permanently** row (order 500, after archive at 400)
in the session row's `…` menu. No hover button.

Every check that can refuse — identity, location, and whether the session is
running — runs before the first durable write, so a refusal leaves the session
exactly as it was. Confirming then stops a running turn through the registry's own
archive admission seam (putting the borrow

plugins.description: A Restart button for DeepSeek Harness Settings: replaces the dsh web process serving the page, then reconnects the page by itself.
plugins.readme_text: **A Restart card in DeepSeek Harness Settings.** One click replaces the `dsh web` process that is serving your page — and the page reconnects by itself. No terminal, no re-opening the desktop icon. That matters because some changes cannot hot-reload: - you changed a plugin's **host half**, and Node caches imported ES modules by URL; - you edited `config.json`, the port, or the workspace; - a session holds in-memory state you want gone. Today those mean walking back to a terminal. This plugin turns them into one click. ## Try it ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:chenkui-luo/dsh-plugin-restart ``` Then **refresh the page once** and open **Settings → Restart**. Without the `dsh` CLI (no pnpm, or a patched profile): copy the package into `/node_modules/dsh-plugin-restart` and add this row to `/cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: restart name: 'dsh-plugin-restart' ``` The bundled installer does both steps with a backup and a read-back check before it writes: ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 -Action disable powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 -Action uninstall ``` ## What happens when you click | Step | What runs | | --- | --- | | 1 | The page sends `POST /dsh-restart/restart` — same origin, authenticated | | 2 | The host half starts a **detached helper** and answers the request *before* anything is stopped | | 3 | The helper waits for the port to stop accepting connections, then hands over to your launcher | | 4 | The launcher starts a fresh `dsh web` with a new launch token and writes its token file | | 5 | The helper confirms the replacement is up, then lets the old process exit — gracefully | | 6 | The page sees a new instance id on its next poll and reloads itself | Nothing is force-killed in the middle of the response, and the old process is stopped **last**, by itself. A restart that fails leaves a diagnosis in the log instead of failing silently. ## Why the helper is a detached **node** process This part was measured on a real Windows machine, not assumed: | how a background helper is started | does it run | does it outlive the process it must replace | | --- | --- | --- | | PowerShell, `detached: true` | **no** — exits 0, silently | — | | PowerShell, attached | yes | no — dies with its parent | | **node, `detached: true`** | yes | **yes** | | node, attached | yes | no | On Windows a "detached" PowerShell child gets no console and never runs the script — the same trap [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) documents. An attached helper dies together with the process it is supposed to replace. So the helper is a detached node process, and it gives its own children a hidden console through `powershell -WindowStyle Hidden`. Force-killing the whole tree is the other half of the story: it leaves a Windows port unbindable long enough for the replacement to die with `EADDRINUSE`. Waiting for the port to go quiet and only then starting the replacement is what makes the handover reliable. ## Verified, not asserted | Check | Result | | --- | --- | | Helper generation, offline (`runtime-test/CheckHelperScript.mjs`) | 11/11 | | End to end, real plugin code (`runtime-test/VerifyRestartPlugin.mjs`) | 21/21 | | **Real** launcher + **real** `dsh web`, full restart cycle (`runtime-test/SmokeRestartReal.ps1`) | pass | The end-to-end runs cover: the installer writing a managed patch row, the host half claiming its routes, an unauthenticated request being fenced off, the restart being accepted before the port goes away, a second click inside the guard window being refused, the port wait, the launcher handover, the successor process appearing, and the page noticing it. These live in the toolkit this plugin was built in; this repository is the packaged plugin. ## API Every route passes the connection trust fence (loopback peer + matching `Origin` + login cookie), so only an authenticated same-origin page can reach them. | Method | Path | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | GET | `/dsh-restart/status` | `instanceId` (this server's pid), port, workspace, launcher path and availability, whether a restart is in flight | | POST | `/dsh-restart/restart` | Arms a restart. A second request within 15 s gets `409`. The response carries **no** launch token | | GET | `/dsh-restart/log` | Tail of the shared restart log | If the automatic reload comes back unauthenticated — a fresh launch token is minted on every start — the page's own token is handed back to the *same* browser connection once, so it can reopen itself with `?token=…`. ## Logs `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\restart-plugin\logs\restart.log` — append-only, so the record of a restart survives the process that performed it. The helper writes the launcher's exit code, whether the port is still being served, and whether a fresh token file appeared, because the process that would normally log a failure is the one that just exited. ## Configuration | Variable | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `DSH_RESTART_INSTALL_DIR` | Launcher runtime directory (default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness`) | | `DSH_RESTART_DATA` | Plugin-private data directory (default `\restart-plugin`) | | `DSH_RESTART_LAUNCHER` | Point at another launcher script (portable installs, tests) | **Restart target.** By default it delegates to the launcher a hosted install already has (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\Launch-DeepSeekHarness.ps1`), which owns the reliable stop/start/readiness sequence. When that file is missing the button reports a clear error instead of pretending to work, and the status card shows the path it looked for. Making the plugin fully standalone is the next step on the roadmap. ## Safety - Authenticated same-origin loopback only; proxy-forwarded requests are not honoured. - No admin rights, no system configuration touched. - It **interrupts a running conversation turn** — that is what a restart is, and the card says so. - If the port is owned by a process the launcher does not recognise (a `dsh web` you started by hand), the restart takes that port over, including its terminal's process tree. ## Credits - **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** — the open-source agent harness this plugin extends and is built on: its `dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml` declaration, the dual host/browser plugin shape, and the webserver's trust fence. [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · MIT. - **[dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)** — the community plugin market. Its `restart.js` is the reference for the approach used here: delegate to a detached helper, wait for the port instead of guessing with a fixed delay, and make a failed restart leave evidence. ## License MIT

plugins.description: Side-by-side session grid for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: click sessions in the sidebar, get an equal-cell grid of live conversations (max 3 per row), drag the top-right handle to reorder, each pane keeps its own composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-multi-chat

**Side-by-side sessions for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, as an equal-cell grid.**
Click a session in the left sidebar and it joins the conversation area as its own pane: one
click → one session, three clicks → three sessions. At most **three panes per row**; the grid
degrades to two or one column when the window is narrow. The session you clicked (the shell's
current session) stays highlighted, every pane keeps its own bottom-pinned input box, and panes
can be reordered by dragging the **⠿ handle in the top-right corner** of a pane header.

中文说明：[README.zh.md](README.zh.md) · 设计依据：[docs/design.md](docs/design.md) ·
Design notes (EN): [docs/design.en.md](docs/design.en.md)

---

## What it does

| | |
|---|---|
| **Follow the sidebar** | Every session you click in the sidebar becomes a pane. The pane order survives a page reload. |
| **Equal-cell grid** | At most three equal cells per row (`3 × 3` = 9 panes max, six by default). Rows share the height but never below a comfortable pane height (~420 px); beyond that the grid scrolls. Narrow windows degrade 3 → 2 → 1 columns. |
| **Highlight** | The current session's pane is ringed, its title emphasized, and its sequence badge inverts. |
| **Focus by click** | Clicking inside a non-active pane asks the shell to make that session current (the official sidebar highlight follows). |
| **Reorder by drag** | Grab the ⠿ handle at the top-right of a pane header (immediate drag) or press the header itself (4 px of travel, or a 300 ms hold on touch). Drop on another pane to **swap** the two, drop on empty grid space to move the pane to the end, `Esc` cancels. The dragged pane follows the pointer as a ghost card and the drop target is outlined. |
| **Reorder by keyboard** | The handle is focusable: `Ctrl/⌘ + arrows` swaps with the neighbouring cell (grid-aware for up/down), otherwise nothing happens. |
| **Close** | Each pane has a close control. The active pane can only be closed by handing the shell over to a sibling — otherwise the control is disabled with a reason. The toolbar's **Keep only active** collapses the grid. |
| **Sidebar toggle** | Each session row gets an extra action button (next to archive/pin) that adds/removes that session as a pane **without** navigating. |
| **Degrade, never break** | A single pane → the official single-session UI is used untouched. Unknown/closed sessions render a note card. A crashed pane is contained by a pane-level error boundary. No `slots`/`sessions` service → the plugin stays inert instead of failing the web boot. |

## Install

The package is a DSH bundle plugin: the host half (`.` → `lib/index.js`) only exists so the
package becomes a loader entry; the browser half (`./client` → `lib/client.js`) is what the web
shell loads through the `dsh.client` declaration.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<path-to-this-package>
# then restart the desktop app / profile (bundle layers apply at boot)
```

Read-only check that the row composes (writes nothing):

```powershell
dsh --profile desktop --dump-config | Select-String dsh-multi-chat
```

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-multi-chat`.

## Development

```powershell
npm install    # dev-only: react, react-dom, jsdom, yaml, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots
npm test       # 7 suites, 90 tests
npm run typecheck
```

**v0.3.0 feature — the grid can be switched off**: pick **Settings → Plugins → dsh-multi-chat** and flip
*Enable the side-by-side grid* (or press **Exit grid** in the grid toolbar). Off returns the conversation area to
the official single-session view; the panes you had opened are remembered, so switching back on brings the grid
straight back. The preference is stored separately from the pane order, so toggling can never disturb it.

**v0.2.6 fix**: the official turn navigator (the tick rail with turn previews on the right of a
conversation) hid itself inside every pane, because the official stylesheet hides it whenever its
conversation container is narrower than 900px. One pane-scoped rule with higher specificity restores it
(the official class prefix is read from the official stylesheet at runtime, and nothing is injected when
that stylesheet is missing). Verified live: the rail renders 28×102px with its marks inside a 456px pane.

**v0.2.5 fix**: the column count was hard-coded to three, so two sessions left a third of the row empty.
The grid now fills: columns follow the available width (`auto-fit` collapses the tracks no pane lands in),
two panes share the row, and three across appears only when the width allows — panes stay at least ~400px
wide. Measured at a 1680px window: two panes = 2×688px (100% of the row), three = 3×456px, four = 3+1
equal cells.

**v0.2.4 change**: the grid is a wide-window feature, so a narrow window keeps the official single
session view. Below 720px of window width the plugin is completely inert — no session is retained, no
slot is replaced, and nothing is written to the shared storage (which the floating session window would
otherwise clobber with its own pane set). Widening the window brings the grid back; narrowing hands the
conversation area back. Verified live: 490×640 cold start shows the normal conversation, 1680×1050 shows
the grid, resizing switches both ways.

**v0.2.3 fix**: in a narrow window (the ~490 px floating session window) the grid toolbar wrapped into
three lines and squeezed the conversation. It now never wraps and degrades by width — dropping the drag
hint, then the usage counter, swapping the title for a compact "N panes" label — and the row height
yields to short windows (`min(420px, 62vh)`). Measured in a 490×640 window: one 37 px line, single
column, composer fully visible.

**v0.2.2 fixes** (reported from a live session, located in a real browser): the grid used to be
registered in a *session-scoped* slot, which the renderer remounts whenever the shell switches
session — so every switch rebuilt the grid and all pane conversations (the lag that grew with the
number of panes) and replaced the composer input mid-click (the "needs a second click to focus"
bug). The grid now lives in the **root-scope `main` / `conversation` panel cell** (same replacement
semantics, no remount), and pane activation runs on `focusin`/`click` instead of `pointerdown`.
Measured live: one click focuses the composer, session switching ≈ one frame, 5 panes ≈ 2.6k DOM
nodes with off-screen panes virtualised. Details: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) §4.9.

**v0.2.1 fixes**: switching a session no longer walks a `retain` → publish → `retain` recursion (it
used to overflow the stack, slow every switch down and leave the pane ring and the sidebar highlight
disagreeing); dragging can no longer strand a ghost or a drop ring when the pointer is released
outside the grid; the selection ring is a single crisp outer ring instead of a double-drawn edge.
Details and the reproduction evidence: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) §4.8.

| Suite | Covers |
|---|---|
| `tests/manifest.test.mjs` | package/bundle/client-half/patch/locale contract, plus "the composer fix stays in place" |
| `tests/host.test.mjs` | the inert host half never throws |
| `tests/store.test.mjs` | pane ledger: follow adds panes, ceiling 6/9, eviction, highlight, `swap`/`moveToEnd`, persistence + the v1→v2 migration, untrusted payloads, drop targeting, keyboard steps |
| `tests/registration.test.mjs` | activation contract: no registration for one pane, shadow registration for 2+, retention/release, sidebar button, unknown sessions, disposal, missing services |
| `tests/real-slot-core.test.mjs` | the same wiring driven through the **real** `SlotCore` shipped by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` |
| `tests/render.test.mjs` | structural rendering: equal-cell grid, single highlight, handle + close per header, `variant: 'embedded'` for the conversation body, hero/settling phases, token-only stylesheet |
| `tests/interaction.test.mjs` | React DOM in jsdom: pointer drag → swap, drop on empty → move to end, `Esc` cancel, header 4 px threshold, `Ctrl+Arrow` keyboard swap, close/focus, sidebar toggle, toolbar, pane-level crash containment |

plugins.description: 一个让provider会走代理的插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-provider-proxy

给 **DeepSeek Harness**（`0.2.0-rc.1` 及以上）用的插件：在 **设置** 里为**每个 provider 单独配置**「这个 provider 要不要走代理」，填写代理类型 + IP/端口。只有被你打开开关的 provider 走代理，其余 provider 和 DSH 的其它流量保持原来的直连路径。

支持官方桌面版（DSH Desktop）与 `dsh web`。

## 安装

先确保已构建过产物（`lib/index.js`、`lib/client.js`）：

```sh
npm install
npm run build
```

桌面版（**必须先完整打开一次桌面版以初始化 profile，然后完全退出**，否则安装命令会拒绝执行）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\gitwork\dsh-provider-proxy
```

Web：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-provider-proxy
```

安装后重启对应应用。设置项写在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`。

## 使用

打开 **设置**，左侧导航里会出现一项 **Provider 代理**（英文界面为 *Provider Proxy*）。
页面里每个 provider 一张卡片，各自独立配置：

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 开关 | 该 provider 是否走代理 |
| 类型 | `HTTP` / `HTTPS`（`SOCKS5` 目前未实现，选它会给出提示） |
| IP / 主机 | 只填主机名或 IP，不要带 `http://` 或路径 |
| 端口 | 1–65535 的整数 |
| 用户名 | 可选 |

列表只包含**已激活**的 provider（`llm.listProviders()` 能列出的那些）。仅在配置里声明、
但没有实际注册的可配置 provider 不显示——它的请求根本不会被发出去。
已经在 `providers` 里配过代理的条目即使暂时不激活也仍然保留，避免已保存的设置悄悄消失。

保存立即对新请求生效，不需要重启；正在进行中的流会继续用它启动时的那条连接。

> **为什么是独立设置页，而不是内嵌在 Models 的 provider 卡片里？**
> 本插件最早按卡片内嵌（`settings.models.provider-card`）实现，但那个槽位是 keyed 的、
> 按 provider 命名空间派发，第三方注册在 0.2.0-rc.1 上始终匹配不上——不报错、不发请求、
> 界面上什么都不出现。独立分区（`settings.section`）是同一 profile 下
> `dsh-llm-retry-settings` 已被验证可用的机制。

## 它是怎么工作的

0.2.0 没有「给单个 provider 注入 transport」的官方口子，这是核对过源码的结论：

- `llm-deepseek` 直接调用全局 `fetch`，请求参数里没有 `dispatcher`；
- `llm-pi-ai` 走 pi-ai SDK 自己的 HTTP，DSH 无法配置；
- `LlmCallControls` 只有 `reasoningEffort` / `temperature` / `maxTokens` / `stop`；
- `llm/stream` 拦截的是**已解码的** `StreamChunk`，发生在 HTTP 之后；
- `ctx.web` 只服务 `web_search` / `web_fetch`，与 provider 流量无关；
- 官方的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy` 是**库**不是插件：`installGlobalProxy` 是模块私有函数，没有 service、没有 Config、只有从环境变量解析出的一份进程级策略。

所以请求在唯一还能拿到线索的地方被路由：`llm/stream` waterfall 的 `options.provider`。用一个 `AsyncLocalStorage` 把选中的 dispatcher 带到流上，再由一层很薄的 `globalThis.fetch` 包装把它交给 fetch。

两个关键点：

1. **每个 provider 各自持有一个 dispatcher**（而不是共用一个），所以即使两个 provider 指向同一个上游主机，也不可能互相串用对方的代理。
2. **流的惰性消费必须被处理**：adapter 的 HTTP 调用通常发生在后续的 `next()` 里，那时 `als.run()` 早已返回。所以每次迭代器的 `next/return/throw` 都会被重新包进作用域里 —— 这正是旧版实现在这里踩过的坑，仓库里有对应的回归测试。

代价是这一个全局 `fetch` 包装：作用域之外的行为与原生完全一致，作用域之内若调用方已经自带 `dispatcher` 也不会被覆盖。

## 已知限制

- **SOCKS5 未实现。** `undici` 的 `ProxyAgent` 只会用 HTTP CONNECT 连 HTTP 代理，对 SOCKS5 需要另写连接器。界面里会明确提示，而不是悄悄按 HTTP 路由。
- **上游若绕过 `globalThis.fetch` 自行建连，则不受影响。** `llm-deepseek` 确认是调用时解析全局 `fetch`；`llm-pi-ai` 走外部 SDK，抓取 `fetch` 的时机未能在源码层面确证。
- **不支持 PAC**，也不读取系统代理设置。
- **不改写 `baseURL`** —— 反向代理/中转请直接在 provider 上配置。
- **代理不可达时**请求照常失败，DSH 既有的重试与错误码语义不变。
- 代理密码不进 `cordis.patch.yml`：配置里只存凭据引用名，密码本身走 credentials 服务。
- **代理用户名可用，密码尚未接入。** `passwordRef` 字段已预留并默认留空，UI 上只提供用户名输入框。

## 如何验证代理确实生效

插件本身不显示出口 IP。可靠的判断方式是在代理端看日志，或临时把端口改成
一个没人监听的端口——如果请求失败并报 `ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:<该端口>`，
就说明请求确实是被代理承载的（直连时报错会指向目标站点）。

仓库里的 `tests/proxy-routing-proof.test.ts` 就是用这个思路做的：起一个会记录
连接的假代理，断言「启用的路由收到 1 次连接、未配置的 provider 收到 0 次」。

## 开发

```sh
npm run build      # 构建 lib/index.js 与 lib/client.js
npm test           # 69 个用例，跑的是构建产物
npm run typecheck  # 类型检查（仅覆盖 src/）
npm run verify     # 上面三件事，按顺序
```

`lib/` 是构建产物，不入库；包上的 `prepare` 脚本会在 `npm publish` 以及从 git
地址安装时自动重建。直接 `dsh plugin add <克隆目录>` 前请先执行
`npm install && npm run build`。

浏览器半必须输出 client module system 的 lazy-CJS factory 格式（脚本本身只注册工厂，所有副作用都在工厂闭包里执行），`scripts/build.mjs` 负责这件事，格式与 DSH 自带插件一致。

## 发布

```sh
npm run verify          # 先确认全绿
npm version patch       # 0.2.0 -> 0.2.1
npm publish
git push --follow-tags
```

plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 真的玩 Minecraft：AI 有自己的角色，能探索、挖矿、合成、熔炼、打怪、建造。基于 yzi1b/whale-craft 独立维护。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mc-agent —— DSH 的「我的世界」插件（魔改版）

DSH 原生 Minecraft Agent 插件：一台无头机器人（mineflayer）跑在 DSH 进程里，模型用 `mc_*` 工具
走路、挖建、合成、熔炼、存取箱子、打怪、用物品（扔眼睛/射箭/喝药水）、聊天、看第一人称截图。

上游是 [whale-craft](https://github.com/yzi1b/whale-craft)（作者 yzi1b）；**本项目已改名为
`dsh-mc-agent`** 并做了大量魔改，本仓库在 <https://github.com/blueziii/dsh-mc-agent>，
上游原版的完整插件说明在 [插件说明.md](插件说明.md)。

| | |
| --- | --- |
| 项目目录（**唯一可编辑源**） | `%USERPROFILE%\Desktop\agent\dsh-mc-agent` |
| 安装位置 | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-mc-agent` —— **指向本项目目录的 junction**（profile 里写的是 `link:…`）⇒ 改完**不用再往包里拷**，重启 DSH 即生效 |
| 本目录的 `node_modules\` | 103 个 junction，指回 profile 的 `node_modules`（与宿主共用同一份依赖，不用自己 `pnpm install`） |
| vendor 依赖 | pathfinder / collectBlock / tool / pvp / autoEat 在 `<profile>\vendor\mc-deps\`（见 [PATHFINDER.md](PATHFINDER.md)）；`loadMcDep` 还有 `$DSH_HOME\profiles\*\vendor\mc-deps\…` 兜底，插件包装成链接也不会静默丢 |
| 上游仓库 / `CHANGELOG.md` 里的旧名字 | **历史，保持原样**（`github.com/yzi1b/whale-craft`） |

## 装到自己的 DSH

前提：DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（`node >= 22`）、一台能连的 Minecraft Java 服务器（离线登录也支持）。

```powershell
# 1) 插件本体（profile 目录，默认 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop）
cd $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add github:blueziii/dsh-mc-agent

# 2) 5 个 mineflayer 插件：走路 / 挖矿采集 / 自动换工具 / 打怪 / 自动吃
pnpm add mineflayer-pathfinder mineflayer-collectblock mineflayer-tool mineflayer-pvp mineflayer-auto-eat
```

然后在同一个 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里加一项 `"dsh-mc-agent"`，重启 DSH。

- **第 2 步别省**：少装哪个就少一项能力，而**没装 `mineflayer-pathfinder` 时 `mc_move` 的走路会直接拒绝**
  （`via: "pathfinder-unavailable"` —— 宁可不动也不盲跳；只有"在水里游"和"原地跳"还能用）。
  插件按 `vendor 树 → 宿主 node_modules` 的顺序找它们，`pnpm add` 装在 profile 里就能被找到。
- 想改代码：把仓库 clone 到任意位置，依赖那行写成 `"dsh-mc-agent": "link:C:/你的路径/dsh-mc-agent"`
  （软链，改完不用往包里拷，重启 DSH 即生效）。
- 装完体检：`node tools\check-mc-deps.mjs`（5 个插件都解析得到、宿主解析器那个尾斜杠地雷不在）。
- 离线自检（29 个套件 + selfcheck，不需要游戏服务器）：`node tools\check-all.mjs`。
- 进游戏：跟它说"连 127.0.0.1:25565，名字叫 xxx"，或者直接让它调 `mc_connect`。
  装好后 DSH 设置里会多一个「MC设置」页（改 `RULES.md`、看记忆目录、开关看门狗）。

## 跑自检

一条命令跑完（推荐）：

```powershell
cd %USERPROFILE%\Desktop\agent\dsh-mc-agent
node tools\check-all.mjs                 # 全部 30 项（29 个套件 + selfcheck），最后给一张 ✓/✗ 表
node tools\check-all.mjs --fast          # 跳过 selfcheck
node tools\check-all.mjs --only mc_auto  # 只跑名字里带这段的
```

套件自己会收拾现场：建过临时目录的（`check-mc-auto`、`check-mc-observe-host`）跑完就删，
想留现场加 `--keep`。（2026-10-08 发现 `check-mc-auto` 每跑一次往 `%TEMP%` 留 2 个
`mc-auto-mem-*`/`mc-auto-wsmem-*`，已经堆到 206 个，那次一起清了。）

单跑某一条也行（括号里是期望结果）：

```powershell
node tools\check-mc-craft.mjs            # 184/0（含"窗口事件丢了但东西到手了"不谎报失败、⑧ 合成窗口失步、缺料报链条、⑨ 一次只做一批会自己补上、⑩⑪ 挂了太久不悄悄开第二条链）
node tools\check-mc-furnace.mjs          # 267/267（含"取成品后背包晚 2.5 秒才同步也不谎报失败"、"放熔炉被拒就换点位重试"）
node tools\check-mc-chest.mjs            # 126/126
node tools\check-mc-auto.mjs             # 233/0（含 3.5 自保：被打了只叫醒 AI、不自己跑也不还手；3.6 憋气；3.7 busy 期间照样检测）
node tools\check-call-budget.mjs         # 139/139（单次调用 ≤11 秒 + ⑩ 移动抢占 + ⑩.5 别人的 goal_reached + ⑪ 领号/认中断/预算到点三件套：jump·swim·flyTo 的 abort 与抢占、收尾调 setGoal(null)、waitForChunks 上限、控制位租约、runSequence 的 wait 不谎报）
node tools\check-token-budget.mjs        # 33/0（省 token：描述/参数体积上限 + 结果不许回 pretty-print JSON + 真跑一遍 mc_status 默认视图 + `mc_entities` 不再单独注册）
node tools\check-core-place.mjs          # 73/0（选料只认整方块：火把/门/半砖/楼梯都不拿去搭）
node tools\check-core-entities.mjs       # 46/0（附近有谁：分类/排序/血量走现成助手；实体列表已并进 `mc_observe` 的"程序检测到"，不再单独注册工具）
node tools\check-core-attack.mjs         # 75/0（打谁 + 真打得着：who 认中英文/找不到列名单；⑥ pvp.attack() 立刻 resolve ⇒ 自己等目标死或预算用完、killed/waitedMs/targetHealth 如实报；打死 + 地上有掉落物 ⇒ 结果里带 `pickup` 提醒去捡）
node tools\check-core-dig.mjs            # 42/0（采集超时/出错必须 cancelTask + 松开控制位 + 清僵尸队列；⑥ 够得着就原地挖、按"眼→方块中心"判 reach、要服务端 `block_change` 回包才算挖掉、等回包最多 1200ms（`#awaitServerBreak`）、掉落物按背包差如实报、一个都没捡到时点一句"地上还有 N 个没捡"；②′ 服务端把方块**改回来**（复原）时不许报成功、`multi_block_change` 要按位段真解）
node tools\check-core-digtime.mjs        # 27/0（"挖铁矿要 4.5 秒"：先复刻上游错值证明坑存在（铁矿石镐 4550ms），再验 `bot.digTime` 被修成原版真值（石镐 1302 / 铁镐 870 / 钻石镐 708 / 下界合金 600），以及**拿错工具/品级不够/有药水效果时一个都不许改小**）
node tools\check-core-useitem.mjs        # 37/0（用物品：空手拒绝、hold 上限 3 秒、松手包必须留 400ms 余量）
node tools\check-core-swim.mjs           # 93/93（别淹死：上浮换气、水挖不掉、status 报"头在水下"；⑦ 在水里绕开寻路直接游；⑧ 上浮认中断/领移动号/只松自己的 jump）
node tools\check-core-map.mjs            # 54/0（mc_map 洞穴层：自动判"在地下"、能站/墙/会掉下去、图例不再 [object Object]）
node tools\check-core-inventory.mjs      # 24/24（mc_inventory：同名格子合计成一条、手上那叠不再重复数一遍）
node tools\check-core-equip.mjs          # 56/0（动手前换对工具 + **时间不够就不开始挖**（挖一半到点松手 = 进度清零）、换不上直接拒绝、挖不动按 digTime 说实话）
node tools\check-core-evidence.mjs       # 40/0（**报了成功有没有证据**：chatSay 拒斜杠指令、toss 对账、useBlock 容器/门/实体三种返回、#aimAt 不依赖 lookAt）
node tools\check-session-memory.mjs      # 13/0（记忆按会话分：落点/兜底/播种/默认关）
node tools\check-rules-file.mjs          # 78/0（规则放在文件里：注入只投一行指针、版本提示.md 可改可恢复、新会话从基根播种它）
node tools\check-mc-observe-host.mjs        # 96/0（默认=AI 自主；--gate-on 110/0）（含三段式感知：看到/检测到/不确定、两套射线互相印证、`percept:false` 退回旧摘要）
node tools\check-mc-view-render.mjs      # 112/0（含手持物色块：带 xN 后缀也要认得出是什么）
node tools\check-mc-skin.mjs             # 78/0（含"坏响应不落盘、坏缓存删掉重下、失败 30 秒后可重试"）
node tools\check-mc-pathfinder.mjs       # 24/0（"走不动"的回归：贴墙穿模算碰撞、斜切拐角禁掉）
node tools\check-watch-chat.mjs          # 21/21（"我打的字它看不到"的回归：旁观模式靠 anyChat 兜底）
node tools\check-audit-session.mjs       # 44/0（会话/状态层审计 F1–F12：自动重连真的连得上、满 200 条也能等到新事件、幽灵在线不再报 online:true、注入失败会留话）
node tools\check-logging.mjs             # 52/52（本地时间/级别/进程内去重/轮转 + 旧噪声不许回潮）
node tools\check-mc-deps.mjs             # 9/0（**给 vendor 树 npm install 之后必跑**）
```
